messages.text: BL-1768 🎵 in progress — The land step's superseded-stray check (BL-1670) accepts a conflicting rewrite only from the stray's OWN ticket, so a closed-owner doc stray whose one missing line another ticket rewrote after the owner landed - BL-1703's a225d85d8b, whose `Last Updated:` line BL-1699's f729af01b9 rewrote after BL-1703's land d51983e4a9 - aborts every land after a ~20 min walk (BL-1748, BL-1764 on 2026-09-26, both hand-built under condition (g)): a third ground decides superseded when every line the stray adds that origin/main lacks sits in a conflicting hunk whose main side a descendant of the owner's landed commit last wrote
